title.narrative: PIMS-9846 Biodiversity Finance Plan Antigua & Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica, Grenada, St. Kitts & Nevis, Saint Lucia

description.narrative: The aim of the project is to develop BFP, which should assess the root causes of biodiversity loss, identify national biodiversity finance gaps, and articulate strategies on how to reduce the gaps through a suite of finance solutions aimed at reducing flow of resources that cause harm to biodiversity; generating additional resources; and enhancing the effectiveness and efficiency of resource use.
